eventtitle: Breaking the legacy barrier: How AI is revolutionizing modernization
description: Enterprises remain trapped in legacy monoliths that drain millions in maintenance while stifling innovation. Traditional modernization approaches like event storming rely heavily on fragmented human knowledge and incomplete documentation, making transformation slow and risky. An AI-driven approach can compress legacy code analysis from months to hours, uncovering hidden business rules and forgotten workflows. In this talk, we share how we partnered with NIE to modernize two legacy Java 8 applications—E-Registration and Student Feedback on Teaching—into modern .NET 10 + Vue.js architectures using AI-powered tools like AWS Transform and Kiro, accelerating modernization outcomes dramatically.
